description: Plan a buy of a stock token on Robinhood Chain for `wallet` that waits for a price: when the pool price goes `trigger` below or above `price_usd`, keyfo prepares a buy of `usd` or `eth` and a sign link. Nothing is bought or signed now. The plan starts after the wallet’s owner confirms it at https://keyfo.xyz/app. The price is the pool’s 5-minute median from at least 5 samples, and the level must hold for about 3 minutes. Only pools with at least $250000 of depth qualify, and no buy is prepared if the route costs more than 3% above the median. The owner then has 6 hours to sign. It is not a limit order: the buy goes at the market price when it is signed. One time by default; with `repeat`, it waits again after each buy. Limits as for scheduled buys: 5 plans per wallet, $500 per buy, $1000 a week.

eth.description: ETH to spend on the buy. Give usd or eth, not both.
eth.title: Eth

price_usd.description: The price in dollars that starts the buy, like 160.
price_usd.title: Price Usd

repeat.description: true waits for the price again after each buy. Default: false, one buy.
repeat.title: Repeat

token.description: Ticker, like NVDA, or the token address.
token.title: Token

trigger.description: below or above: buy when the pool price drops below or rises above price_usd.
trigger.title: Trigger

usd.description: Dollars of ETH to spend on the buy, at the ETH price when it is prepared. Up to 500.
usd.title: Usd

wallet.description: The wallet that buys and signs. Its owner confirms the plan at https://keyfo.xyz/app.
wallet.title: Wallet
